contentList.content: A stranger hears only silence and feels the weight of stone, but a druid can make out the whisper of roots and the distant roll of thunder. The pendant will not suffer a foreign hand: to all but those chosen by the Circle, it stays dull and useless.
The pendant will not suffer a foreign hand: to all but those chosen by the Circle, it stays dull and useless.
While Concentrating on a spell, you gain +[1] to your Spell Save DC. Your spells also deal [2].
While you have Lightning Charges, you gain +[1] to all Saving Throws.
You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">Concentration</LSTag> Saving Throws.
